name: split-flap-board
title: Split-Flap Board
description: Your latest commit on a split-flap board, live from GitHub. Each flap falls under gravity and bounces off the stop, cells turn through the alphabet to their letter and settle at their own pace, and the light from above shades every fall. Hover and the rows below turn over to the commits before. SplitFlapBoardLive polls an endpoint returning { user, commits } (see /api/recent-commits in the docs).
